recognize_zh: 這是 RT-PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，每一 lane 上方都有 RNA 內部對照帶；病人檢體（粉紅箭頭）的 BCR::ABL1 產物帶與 b2a2（e13a2）陽性對照同高，而較高的條帶則對應 b3a2（e14a2），據此判讀病人為 b2a2 型融合轉錄本。
features: Agarose gel electrophoresis of RT-PCR products with lanes labeled B2 (b2a2 control), 1-8 and B3 (b3a2 control)
Upper internal RNA control band present in sample lanes, confirming RNA integrity
Lanes 1-4 show a band at the higher b3a2-size position
Lanes 5-6 lack a specific BCR::ABL1 band, showing only faint low-molecular-weight bands
Patient sample lane (arrow) and lane 8 show a band co-migrating with the b2a2 control
describe_en: Agarose gel of RT-PCR products for BCR::ABL1 transcripts shows an upper internal RNA control band in the sample lanes, confirming amplifiable RNA. The patient sample, indicated by the arrow, shows a specific product co-migrating with the b2a2 (e13a2) positive control, which runs lower than the b3a2 (e14a2) control. Lanes 1-4 show a b3a2-size product and lanes 5-6 show no specific band. The result indicates a p210 BCR::ABL1 fusion transcript of the e13a2 (b2a2) type, consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in the appropriate clinical context.
